content.contents: looks nice! digiex in the corner, from when 4evrx was using digital exorcism as a label. cool shit! very similar to the cover of loving the wired, save for the powerlines overlaid and the change of placement for the digiex logo. some of you, maybe the two of you reading, may remember a photo of a few CDs i did for this release. i made them myself, you can see them here:

perhaps to the dismay of some fans, these were never listed anywhere for sale! a shame, right? so what happened to them? i gave them to a local record store to hand out for free. i never heard back about them, even though i had put my email on the inside, either people hadn't listened or they didn't care enough. fair enough i guess ;;
